name: Loudoun County Public Schools
districtFact: LCPS publishes a student school calendar along with separate A/B rotation resources and employee calendars.

about.title: About the LCPS Calendar
about.content: This resource follows the LCPS student school calendar. LCPS also publishes A/B rotation schedules and additional employee calendars, so staff members and families using a specialized program should confirm the calendar assigned to them.

districtFaqs.q: Does every LCPS program follow the same calendar?
districtFaqs.a: This page follows the LCPS student school calendar. LCPS also publishes A/B rotation resources and separate employee calendars. Check the official LCPS calendar page and your school or program before relying on districtwide dates.

districtFaqs.q: Where does LCPS post weather-related schedule changes?
districtFaqs.a: LCPS posts closures, delayed openings, and early dismissals on its website and sends divisionwide notifications to families. The district also publishes updates through its official social media channels and local radio and television stations.
